sources.title: KindredBueno|16.19|The Eternal Hunters' Definitive Jungling Guide

passive.name: Mark of the Kindred
passive.text: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

spells.name: Dance of Arrows
spells.text: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.

spells.name: Wolf's Frenzy
spells.text: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him. Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.

spells.name: Mounting Dread
spells.text: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.

spells.name: Lamb's Respite
spells.text: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

archetype.value: Kindred is an ADC jungler with a unique, mark-focused playstyle.

winCondition.value: Kindred can snowball when fed and significantly affect teamfights or objectives with Lamb's Respite.

spikes.why: Kindred gains 75 attack range and a boost to their abilities.
Kindred gains basic attack range in addition to the permanent basic-ability empowerment from completed Hunts.

bait.why: Kindred cannot tumble and fire Dance of Arrows again while its 9-second cooldown runs.

mistakes.value: Kindred players can die by chasing marks they should leave alone.
Kindred misses permanent empowerment when Hunts are left unfinished.
